hero.name: Jeshin
hero.tagline: I build reliable APIs and infrastructure that scale.

about.label: ABOUT ME
about.body: I'm a backend developer who turns business requirements into stable server architecture and data models — using AI to move faster while verifying quality and reliability myself. At 42Seoul I built my computer-science and systems-programming foundations through project-based work, and I develop backend services and cloud environments with Python (FastAPI), Java (Spring Boot), and AWS. I want to grow into an engineer who weighs scalability and operations together.

backend.title: BACKEND DEVELOPMENT
backend.subtitle: Designing & building server-side systems
backend.body: REST API design, authentication and authorization, data modeling, and performance-minded server development. I value maintainable structure and clear business logic.

infra.title: INFRA & DEVOPS
infra.subtitle: Shipping and operating services
infra.body: Building Docker-based container environments and AWS infrastructure, with CI/CD for stable, repeatable deployments. I aim for services designed with operations and scaling in mind.

now.label: NOW
now.heading: Growing & job hunting
now.body: Sharpening my backend skills through projects while preparing to join a strong engineering team.

2025.heading: Hyundai AutoEver School — Security (2nd cohort)
2025.body: Studied network, system, and web-application security; AWS and cloud security; Docker/Kubernetes security; WAF/IPS operations; vulnerability assessment and penetration testing; incident response; and ISMS and information-security regulations.

2024.heading: 42Seoul
2024.body: Learned project-first, from defining requirements through design, implementation, and testing. Alongside peer collaboration and code review, I worked on custom library implementation, I/O and file handling, systems programming, data structures and algorithms, OS and servers, graphics and games, and web/full-stack.

2023.heading: Where it began
2023.body: Built my foundations by studying algorithms and networking on my own.
